column1: # AUDIT03 / AUDIT03-B. The runner used to DISCOVER tests with the glob
# `tests/MUnit/**/*Tests.m`, which was wrong in three ways at once:
#   1. it excluded 23 of the 78 .m files under tests/MUnit;
#   2. it never looked outside tests/MUnit at all, so tests/SelfTest.m,
#      tests/MasterRunner.m and the two tests/Nature Level-3 tests were
#      invisible -- an ENTIRE SECOND SUITE, with its own runner, that no
#   3. a glob cannot tell a test from a producer, so widening it would have
#      collected files that export a literal "OK" and cannot fail.
# Renaming was ruled out on evidence: TSK-ALGO-004 and TSK-MIXED-001 are cited
# Membership is therefore DECLARED. A new .m file is neither included nor
# excluded until someone classifies it, and tools/check_test_manifest.sh goes
# red until they do -- which is what makes the "never ran" class impossible to
#   test        collected and scored by run-tests.sh
#   quarantine  excluded: the status does not depend on any computation
#   producer    excluded: writes artefacts, exports no verdict
